english.note: Use 工作 as the all-purpose noun for a job or for tasks that need doing.
This is the all-purpose everyday noun for paid employment and an ordinary task or piece of work.
This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary piece of work or work assignment.
This is the all-purpose noun for a job or regular work.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice when employment means a person's job or work.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose word for someone's job or occupation.
Use this as the all-purpose word for a job or piece of work.
